method:
Builds audit/source_review.json and SOURCE_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md from the analyst review recorded below,
the HTTP link check (audit/source_http_check.json) and the register. The register itself is never modified.
Review method: page text fetched with one request per URL (PDF text via pdftotext), key figures located by
reading, plus targeted web searches for S15, S26 and S32. 'Supports' means the linked page states the claim.

sources.title: Intermountain Ventures
sources.claim: Six investment sectors; early and growth stage; piloting and post-investment support
sources.limitations: Official strategy; not a published check-size policy
sources.review_note: Page states six primary areas, early and growth stage, pilot and support programs.

sources.title: Portfolio | Intermountain Ventures
sources.claim: Portfolio reference to check competitive/portfolio overlap
sources.limitations: Portfolio may change; no guarantee exhaustive
sources.review_note: Portfolio page loads and lists portfolio companies, but company names are not in the static text (rendered as images), so the overlap check cannot be completed from text.
sources.recommended_action: Analyst to inspect the portfolio visually for overlap with Notable, Silna, Tennr, Rhyme.

sources.title: Select Health to simplify member journeys | Select Health
sources.claim: Select Health is an integrated health plan aligned with Intermountain
sources.limitations: Relationship does not imply permission to pilot
sources.review_note: Page is a Select Health press release about a Qualtrics deal; the alignment claim rests only on boilerplate calling Intermountain Health the parent company.
sources.recommended_action: Keep as context. Do not cite for anything beyond corporate affiliation.

sources.title: CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule CMS-0057-F | CMS
sources.claim: Prior auth operational provisions 2026 and API requirements mostly 2027; principally non-drug services
sources.limitations: Covered payers and programs, scope and exceptions matter
sources.review_note: Operational provisions generally from Jan 1, 2026, API requirements generally Jan 1, 2027; drugs excluded from the Patient Access API addition.

sources.title: 2026 CMS Interoperability Standards and Prior Authorization for Drugs Proposed Rule (CMS-0062-P) | CMS
sources.claim: 2026 proposed rule on drug authorization is proposed, not finalized
sources.limitations: Do not state the 2026 drug proposal is final
sources.review_note: Titled as the 2026 proposed rule on prior authorization for drugs (CMS-0062-P).
sources.recommended_action: Keep; state clearly that it is proposed.

sources.title: AMA survey: Prior authorization reform pledge falls short with physicians | American Medical Association
sources.page_date_confirmed: No (registry date 2026-05-13 not visible; only an Oct 9, 2026 string)
sources.claim: 2025 physician survey: 40 PAs per physician each week and 13 hours per practice per week
sources.limitations: Survey responses, not measured national time or per-referral savings
sources.review_note: States an average of 40 prior authorizations per physician per week and 13 hours of physician and staff time per week. Survey self-report.
sources.recommended_action: Keep; confirm the release date in a browser.

sources.title: 2025 CAQH Index Shows U.S. Healthcare Avoided $258 Billion
sources.page_date_confirmed: Yes (Feb 19, 2026, release URL date and excerpts)
sources.claim: 2025 Index highlights $258B costs avoided in 2024 across electronic admin transactions
sources.limitations: Broad administrative transactions, not a referral automation TAM
sources.review_note: CAQH release (GlobeNewswire, Feb 19, 2026): the 2025 CAQH Index estimates $258 billion of administrative cost avoided in 2024, up 17 percent. Access is intermittent: HTTP 403 and 200 on different attempts; on the final recheck the page loaded and the $258 and 2024 figures were present in its text, and CAQH's own blog copy matches. Edition note: this is the 2025 Index (released Feb 2026); S28 uses 2024 Index figures. Some executive-report variants round to about $260 billion.
sources.recommended_action: Keep. Cite the $258 billion figure only as an industry-wide avoided-cost estimate, not a referral or prior authorization TAM.

sources.title: Exclusive: Health tech startup Tennr raises $101 million Series C at $605 million valuation to fix the patient referral process | Fortune
sources.claim: Tennr $101M Series C at reported $605M valuation
sources.limitations: June 2025 snapshot, not current valuation
sources.review_note: Fortune exclusive: Tennr raises $101 million Series C at $605 million valuation. The valuation is a reported figure.
sources.recommended_action: Keep. Historical snapshot, not a current valuation.

sources.title: Healthcare referrals are where patients get lost. Tennr raises $101M to bring the visibility our system desperately needs
sources.claim: Tennr raises $101M Series C and introduces referral network
sources.limitations: Vendor performance metrics self-reported
sources.review_note: Company release states a $101 million Series C led by IVP with a16z, Lightspeed, GV, ICONIQ and others. The 'referral network' product claim was not located in the extracted text.
sources.recommended_action: Keep for the financing fact; verify the product claim in a browser.

sources.title: Introducing Silna, Healthcare’s First Care Readiness Platform - Silna Health
sources.claim: Silna launched with $27M cumulative seed and Series A funding
sources.limitations: $27M total across announced rounds, not one round
sources.review_note: Launch post: $27M led by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures, composed of a $5M seed and a $22M Series A.

sources.title: Introducing Predictive Document Intelligence - Silna Health
sources.claim: Predictive document intelligence; reported support for >150,000 patients
sources.limitations: Company-reported patient count, not independently audited
sources.review_note: States Silna supports 'over 150,000 patients nationwide' and a #1 G2 rating. Self-reported and unaudited.

sources.title: Beyond the Agent: AI Operations, the Team Behind 20x Browser Agent Growth | Silna Engineering
sources.claim: Browser agents; self-described scaling of payer portal workflows
sources.limitations: Reported internal performance is not customer-verified
sources.review_note: Engineering post: more than 75% of prior authorizations go through payer portals; browser agent volume grew 20x over two quarters. Self-reported.

sources.title: AnswersNow Scales Faster and Streamlines Care Access with Silna - Silna Health
sources.claim: AnswersNow case study of turnaround improvement in ABA therapy
sources.limitations: Specialty case, not a generalizable hospital benchmark
sources.review_note: Customer story: authorization time from about 29 days to about 7 days (76% drop). Single customer, vendor-published.
sources.recommended_action: Keep as an anecdote; not evidence of generalizable performance.

sources.title: Rhyme - Eliminating Prior Auth
sources.claim: Provider-payer authorization network and touchless workflows
sources.limitations: Inconsistent volume figures on current website, do not quote precise volume
sources.review_note: Capability claims present. The same page gives conflicting scale figures: 'over 4M prior auths for 83 of the largest providers each year' and '7M+ auths per year, 300+ payers, 2,598 hospitals'. This confirms the screen's 'website volume inconsistency' risk note.
sources.recommended_action: Keep; ask Rhyme which figure is current and how counted.

sources.title: Plenful Raises $50M Series B to Expand AI-Powered Healthcare Automation Platform
sources.claim: Plenful $50M Series B funding; broader pharmacy operations
sources.limitations: Company-issued announcement (PR Newswire, April 30, 2025). $76 million is cumulative disclosed funding, not a valuation. Historical; not evidence of a current round.
sources.review_note: Approved correction applied: the register now points at the direct PR Newswire release, which states a $50 million Series B and $76 million total funding. Company-issued announcement. Cumulative funding is not a valuation. Original index URL retained in lineage.

sources.title: 4x Capacity, 75% Less Manual Work: How We’re Bringing AI-powered Speed to Intake Authorization, End-to-End | Plenful
sources.claim: Intake and specialty pharmacy prior authorization suite
sources.limitations: Performance figures vendor-reported
sources.review_note: Announces an intake authorization management suite covering intake, benefits verification, prior authorization and claim reconciliation.

sources.claim: SamaCare $17M Series B

sources.review_note: Page title: SamaCare Secures $17M Series B Investment to Scale Specialty Drug Prior Authorization Platform.

sources.page_date_confirmed: No (date not on page; registry says 2021-11)
sources.claim: $130M Series C; patient access and referral automation

sources.limitations: Payer-first economics differ from provider pilot
sources.review_note: $90M Series C bringing total funding to $200 million.

sources.claim: $40M financing; cumulative $64M; health plan AI
sources.limitations: Payer-first; not directly a provider intake pilot
sources.review_note: $40 million financing bringing total funding to $64 million. Round label not stated, consistent with the screen.

sources.title: Infinitus Systems raises $51.5 million Series C funding on the strength of AI guardrails
sources.claim: $51.5M Series C; phone-based healthcare workflow AI
sources.limitations: Adjacent channel automation, not end-to-end referral specialist
sources.review_note: Release title: $51.5 million Series C funding.
sources.recommended_action: Keep; confirm Oct 2024 date in a browser.

sources.title: Notable Raises Series B to Expand Intelligent Automation in Healthcare
sources.claim: $100M Series B; existing historical Intermountain patient-access relationship
sources.limitations: Existing historical Intermountain customer mention is critical, 2026 current scope unknown
sources.review_note: $100M Series B led by ICONIQ Growth. Includes an Intermountain Healthcare CIO quote crediting the Notable partnership with a 97 percent patient satisfaction rating. Supports a relationship as of 2021 only.

sources.title: How to reduce prior authorization denials with AI Agents
sources.claim: Prior auth automation workflow with provider examples
sources.limitations: Vendor estimates and case numbers need independent checking
sources.review_note: Vendor article on reducing prior authorization denials with AI agents. Product workflow described; named provider examples were not confirmed in the extracted text.
sources.recommended_action: Keep as product description only; verify if cited for provider examples.

sources.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Assort Health/
sources.page_date_confirmed: Yes (Jun 25, 2026 13:53 ET release; original announcement Jun 24, 2026 per analyst approval)
sources.claim: Reported $120M Series C at $1.2B valuation
sources.limitations: Company-reported and historical (June 2026): a company-stated $1.2 billion valuation and more than $222 million cumulative funding. Not a current October 2026 valuation; cumulative funding is not a valuation. Original announcement June 24, 2026; linked correction release published June 25, 2026.
sources.review_note: Approved correction applied: the register now points at the PR Newswire release stating a $120 million Series C led by Menlo Ventures at a valuation of $1.2 billion and more than $222 million raised. Company-stated, historical (June 2026), not a current October 2026 valuation. Registry date kept as the original announcement date; the linked release is the June 25, 2026 correction.
sources.recommended_action: None further. Label the valuation company-reported and historical.

sources.title: Assort Health Unveils Referrals, the First AI Agent that Handles Processing, Triage, and Continuous Patient Conversations for Every Referral
sources.claim: New referral agent for specialty practices and health systems
sources.limitations: Recent product announcement; maturity to verify
sources.review_note: Announces a Referrals AI agent that processes inbound referrals, confirms eligibility and matches patients. Includes vendor statistics.

sources.title: (no HTML title; PDF)
sources.publisher: CAQH summarized by American Hospital Association
sources.category: Secondary summary (AHA Trailblazers report sponsored by Ailevate; figures attributed to the 2024 CAQH Index)
sources.claim: 2024 CAQH cost/time benchmark prior authorization: manual 24 minutes, electronic 10 minutes
sources.limitations: Directional transaction benchmark only, not realized AI product performance. Published in an American Hospital Association Trailblazers report sponsored by Ailevate. Page 7 table figures (prior authorization 24 minutes manual, 10 minutes fully electronic) are attributed to the 2024 CAQH Index. Industry transaction benchmark: not a validation of any screened vendor and not a measured Intermountain workflow baseline.
sources.review_note: AHA Trailblazers report (AHA Market Scan) sponsored by Ailevate, 10 pages. Page 7 table, attributed to the 2024 CAQH Index Report (Feb 2025): prior authorization $12.88 manual vs $5.38 fully automated, 24 vs 10 minutes. Industry-wide transaction benchmark: not a validation of any screened vendor and not a measured Intermountain baseline. Sponsor is a vendor in a different workflow (claims denials).
sources.recommended_action: Keep as context only. The model's 4, 7 and 10 net minutes are analyst assumptions, not this delta.

sources.title: Annual Report
sources.claim: Intermountain reported use of AI to reduce caregiver time
sources.limitations: Organization-wide description without pilot-level metrics
sources.review_note: Annual report page says the system 'leveraged AI technology and new tools to save time for caregivers'. Qualitative, no figure.

sources.title: Prior Authorization Automation | Silna Health
sources.claim: Prior auth submission, follow-up, renewals and payer requirements
sources.limitations: Website capabilities self-described
sources.review_note: Describes prior authorization submission, follow-up and expiration reminders.

sources.title: Intermountain Healthcare Partners With Notable Health to Expand the My Health+ Digital Platform for Patients
sources.claim: Intermountain announced strategic partnership with Notable for automated patient registration, insurance eligibility and intake, with reported reduction in check-in time
sources.limitations: 2020 historical deployment and company-supplied outcomes; does not confirm active 2026 deployment or PA/referral scope
sources.review_note: Intermountain release: partnership with Notable Health for mobile registration and virtual clinical intake; reports 55 percent of patients completing digital check-in and check-in time down 25 percent, 94 percent satisfaction. Historical only; says nothing about current status.
sources.recommended_action: Keep. Never cite as evidence of a current contract.

sources.claim: H1 2026 US digital health raised $7.4B across 244 deals; financing concentrated in megadeals
sources.limitations: Not equivalent to the referral automation market size
sources.review_note: Healthcare Dive article (published July 16, 2026) reporting Rock Health's midyear data: U.S. digital health companies raised $7.4 billion across 244 deals in H1 2026; 20 mega-deals of $100M or more from 19 companies were 45 percent of capital; median deal $14M. The page returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so confirmation is from search excerpts of the article itself. Q1 was revised from $4.0B (April) to $4.2B.
sources.recommended_action: Open in a browser to read the full article. Consider citing Rock Health's own report.

sources.title: How automation improves patient outcomes at scale
sources.claim: Vendor-reported Intermountain digital intake outcomes
sources.limitations: Not independent; does not establish current vendor contract scope
sources.review_note: States Intermountain digital intake moved 68% of patients to pre-appointment forms, cut check-in time 25% and reached 96% satisfaction. Vendor-reported.

sources.title: Intermountain: 77% Digital Completion on Well-Child Forms | Notable
sources.claim: Intermountain pediatric pre-visit forms case study; 12,500 forms over 3 months
sources.limitations: Historical/vendor reported; do not extrapolate to PA/referrals
sources.review_note: Case study: 12,500 well-child forms completed via automation over 3 months, 77% pre-visit completion, 98% satisfaction. Vendor-published.

sources.title: CMS Announces Early Adopters to Advance Solutions for Electronic Prior Authorization, Accelerating Momentum Ahead of 2027 Requirements | CMS
sources.claim: Electronic prior authorization acceleration initiative and early adopters
sources.limitations: Participation is not verified for subject startups
sources.review_note: CMS Electronic Prior Authorization Acceleration initiative; 29 healthcare organizations signed on as early adopters.

sources.title: Inova Health partners with Notable to support system-wide AI and digital transformation strategy
sources.claim: Inova partnership specifically involves revenue cycle referral management and patient access
sources.limitations: Vendor targets are not independently proven achieved results
sources.review_note: Notable announcement: enterprise agreement with Inova initially focused on revenue cycle, referral management and patient access. About Inova, not Intermountain.
sources.recommended_action: Keep as evidence of Notable's referral-management product scope only.
